description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: send a short query ('stripe.com', 'postgres', 'invoicing') with filters for category, agent level, access or payment. Returns the products we drove, sorted by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped; a task in plain words: choose_provider_for_task, one product in full: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; up to 100 a page.

access.description: Only products an agent gets into this way (signup_without_human: any way without a person; person: a person set it up)

agent_can_buy.description: true: only products our agent paid over x402, MPP or the like

agent_can_leave.description: true: only products our agent cancelled and deleted on its own

category.description: Only this category id or name (list_categories)

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level (0-5) or higher

offset.description: Skip this many matches: the last answer's next_offset

pays_with.description: Only products that take x402, mpp or card; a comma list takes any, e.g. x402,mpp; also l402, stripe-projects, acp, ucp, ap2, mcp-payment

query.description: Name, domain or what it does, e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'invoicing'; every word must match

surface.description: Only products an agent can work by api, mcp, cli or sdk; a comma list wants all, e.g. mcp,cli

name: search_tools
title: Search the directory
